name: PERSTIM
recent: PERSTIM 近期完成第48届常年股东大会，所有决议获通过；同时出现董事与主要股东权益变动，以及董事局与委员会人事调整。公司也发布了季度业绩。
notable: 第48届常年股东大会于2026年8月27日举行，所有决议以投票方式通过。
402,806股普通股（32.846%），列为场外交易申报。
2026年11月20日出现多项董事局及委员会变动，包括Dominic Aw Kian-Wee、Lim Poh Seong、Mastura binti Mansor的职务调整。
risks: 主要股东Ranko Kume的间接持股达32.846%，需留意股权集中情况。
2026年9月3日公告显示董事Ranko Kume的权益变动（场外交易），涉及大量股份。

recent_en: PERSTIM recently completed its 48th AGM with all resolutions approved, alongside changes in director and substantial shareholder interests and board/committee reshuffles. The company also released its quarterly results.
notable_en: The 48th AGM was held on 27 August 2026 and all resolutions were approved by poll.
Miss Ranko Kume held an indirect interest of 42,402,806 ordinary shares (32.846%) as of 1 September 2026, reported as dealings outside closed period.
Several board and committee changes occurred on 20 November 2026, involving Dominic Aw Kian-Wee, Lim Poh Seong and Mastura binti Mansor.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Ranko Kume's indirect stake stands at 32.846%, warranting attention to shareholding concentration.
A 3 September 2026 announcement showed a change in director Ranko Kume's interest (outside closed period) involving a large block of shares.
